text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Duramente.
Her gaze was fixed on a pair of students.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student A
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're the one sitting next to me, right? If you'd like, let's have lunch together!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student B
text_block_list.text: Eh... i-is it really okay with me? Y-Yeah, thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: What's got you staring so intently?
What's got you staring so intently?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ..., I was just remembering. ...About Crown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Once she realized we both carried pride in our houses... she often reached out to me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...In the past, I interacted with others even less than I do now.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yet... Crown alone—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, Duramente-san! Would you like to have lunch together?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! That's a huge serving of natto...! Is it a major favorite of yours?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Protein and dietary fiber. It's rich in nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, so it's for nutritional purposes. I never skip dietary training either, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Not just natto, but boiled eggs and sugar-free yogurt... Wait, no dressing on the broccoli at all?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: To be this thorough...! ...Fufu, I see! Maybe I should reconsider my own menu.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh, Duramente-san! Mind if I sit next to you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...If you wish.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, that tail treatment! It's the one that model was using, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...If maintenance is neglected, it disrupts balance while running.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's true, but... Wait, that other treatment is for the tail too? And you use different brushes for each treatment?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Heh, quite the dedication as expected...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that gave me a great hint. Maybe I should review my grooming tools as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're maintaining your horseshoes. Mind if I watch how you do it from beside you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ............ You are an intriguing girl.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Why do you concern yourself with me so much? ...I doubt there's much entertainment in it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu, because... I just can't help but be curious about you♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: As a horse girl of the Satono family, I thought I was always doing everything flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yet you were putting in even more effort than me! With a cool composure, as if it were only natural!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: As someone shouldering a similar weight of lineage—I genuinely feel like I cannot afford to lose to you!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...So you have reasons you cannot lose either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes! Even if my opponent happens to be you, Duramente-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Know your enemy and know yourself, and you will never be defeated—the ancients truly left behind wise words, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I will devise a perfect plan and seize glory right from your hands!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Unhesitatingly studying someone she acknowledges as a formidable rival.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Day by day, I came to know what kind of person she was—
